purpose: Test whether colour-conditioned Gaussian hypervolume geometry combined with species-disjoint partition transfer distinguishes geography-representable from environment-representable synthetic colour organization. This is a bounded proof of concept, NOT an end-to-end calibration of the 369-species RGFCA or a causal-identification procedure.

coordinates.geography: Independent uniform unit-sphere xyz observations, scaled by sqrt(3). No real photo outcomes or climate values are used in the benchmark.
coordinates.environment: Two globally defined synthetic fourth-harmonic fields: (x^4-6*x^2*y^2+y^4, 4*x*y*(x^2-y^2)), scaled by sqrt(315)/8. These even functions repeat environmental conditions across different geographic positions; they are not CHELSA heat/dryness measurements.
coordinates.availability: Identical coordinate arrays are reused across scenario comparisons within a stage/replicate. Occupancy and observation selection remain fixed when synthetic colour organization changes.
coordinates.confounded_control: For a separate identifiability control set environment=(sqrt(3)*x,sqrt(3)*y) and shared colour response along sqrt(3)*x. Geographic and environmental response are then observationally equivalent; a both-domain result is permitted and must not be forced into one cause.

worlds.geography_shared: One common random geographic plane normal across species.
worlds.environment_shared: One common random environmental plane normal across species.
worlds.species_specific_geography: Independent random geographic plane normal per species, with the same signal amplitude and response shape as geography_shared.
worlds.species_specific_environment: Independent random environmental plane normal per species, with the same signal amplitude and response shape as environment_shared.
worlds.confounded_shared: Same shared signal in overlapping geographic/environmental representations, at amplitude 2 only.

colour_generator: Binary synthetic colour = 1[amplitude * species_random_sign * tanh(projected_coordinate / transition_width) + N(0,1) > 0]. A random sign per species deliberately prevents pooling colour identities across species.

hypervolumes.total_volume: Log volume of a 95% shrinkage-Gaussian ellipsoid ignoring colour; an exact negative-control invariant when only colour labels change.
hypervolumes.colour_partition: Two class-conditional shrinkage-Gaussian distributions with equal priors per training species. Report Bhattacharyya affinity, NOT geometric intersection volume or Jaccard.
hypervolumes.transfer: For each training species fit its two Gaussian distributions, predict a two-class partition for every heldout species in each domain, and calculate adjusted Rand index (ARI) against heldout synthetic colours. ARI is invariant to species-specific colour-label swaps. Average equally across all training x heldout species pairs; pairs lacking >=4 observations per true class contribute zero, not an outcome-selected exclusion. No heldout species is used to fit, tune or orient a predictor.
hypervolumes.not_claimed: Gaussian moments do not recover arbitrary multimodal/holey hypervolumes. Representation-specific recovery is not proof of a unique ecological cause.

calibration.threshold: For each domain and nonzero amplitude take the maximum empirical 97.5th-percentile (method=higher) of transfer scores across the three nuisance calibration worlds. Use strict greater-than rejection. This is composite empirical calibration with a two-domain Bonferroni allocation, not an exact permutation test.
calibration.evaluation: Use disjoint RNG streams for calibration and evaluation. Report geography-only, environment-only, both and neither frequencies for every world, plus per-domain rates and Wilson 95% Monte Carlo intervals. Include independent nuisance evaluation; do not certify 5% error just because the nominal allocation is 5%.
calibration.uncertainty: Wilson intervals condition on estimated calibration thresholds and omit calibration-threshold uncertainty.
calibration.decision: No outcome-dependent seed, amplitude, dimensionality, bandwidth or subset replacement. Failures and both-domain outcomes remain visible.

empirical_geometry_audit.source: SHA-verified geometry-only export from the frozen 50000-row measured table
empirical_geometry_audit.task: Quantify fixed sampling-frame attrition and coordinate coverage separately from the uniform-sphere benchmark. Do not present a geometry audit as empirical hypervolume inference or as a full actual-geometry power simulation.

future_prerequisites: Species-disjoint AND geographic-block holdout with common-support checks
Verified fixed real environmental axes and scaling
No reinterpretation of existing G1, thermal/dryness, C/S or interaction decisions
